newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 4.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
China turns back more than 200 ships carrying foreign rubbish, waste or dangerous materials in 1996.
Premier Li Peng says China hopes to set up a long-term, stable and cooperative relationship with Japan and urges Tokyo to do more to recognise its World War Two aggression.
Economic tsar Zhu Rongji calls for more mergers of lumbering state enterprises and fewer bankruptcies, and vows to curb blind investment.
The Ministry of Finance says it has not yet set the amount of bonds to be issued in 1997 but says the amount will not be less than in 1996.
The China Securities Regulatory Commission fines three stock brokerages for illegally using credit to bid for new share issues.
